name: TikTok Business API Owned-Video Source
changes: Add separate read-only TikTok Business API source service implementing StickerDrop /v1/comments and /v1/replies contract
Use official TikTok Business comment list and reply list endpoints
Restrict supported input to canonical owned /video/<id> URLs
Normalize official image_url as comment_pics without fabricating cmt_sticker_struct
Add cursor pagination, upstream response bounds, redirect rejection, and sanitized errors
Add offline integration tests and deployment documentation
known_limitations: TikTok Business API comments are limited to videos owned by the connected and authorized TikTok account
The service requires a short-term TikTok account access token supplied via environment; automatic refresh is not implemented
The official image_url field is not guaranteed to represent every native TikTok comment sticker
StickerDrop media pipeline accepts valid WebP bytes; other image formats do not qualify yet
This does not support arbitrary public video URLs or photo posts
